name: Gammagamma 25-delta (25Δ) daily range
purpose: Derive the market-priced daily range for an underlying from the strikes of the 25-delta call and 25-delta put on the nearest expiry. Mirrors backend/app/range.py, backend/app/gex.py and backend/app/greeks.py.
source_files: backend/app/gex.py (build_chain_snapshot: expiry filter, IV solve, delta)

definition.upper_bound: call_25d_strike = strike of the call whose delta is closest to +0.25
definition.lower_bound: put_25d_strike = strike of the put whose delta is closest to -0.25
definition.interpretation: Roughly a 25% risk-neutral chance of finishing beyond each bound by expiry. Index skew is put-heavy, so the put bound usually sits farther from spot than the call bound.

inputs.spot: Underlying price S. Precedence: live quote -> put-call parity from the chain -> fixture fallback.
inputs.option_chain: Per contract: strike K, expiration (UTC datetime), type 'C' or 'P', mid = (bid + ask) / 2, open interest, multiplier.

steps.name: Pick the anchor expiry (0DTE)
steps.detail: Among contracts that have a quote and an expiration >= now, take the earliest expiration date. Keep only contracts on that date. This is the 'nearest listed expiry', so on weekends/holidays it rolls to the next session (DTE can be 2-3 days).

steps.name: Time to expiry for greeks
steps.detail: Calendar-time years, floored at 1 day for the IV/delta calculation. (Note: range.py separately computes dte_years floored at 1 hour, used only for the 1-SD move, not for delta.)

steps.name: Solve implied volatility per contract
steps.method: Vectorised Newton-Raphson on Black-Scholes price vs mid. Start sigma = 0.30, step = (BS_price - mid) / vega, sigma clipped to [0.03, 5.0], max 60 iterations, tol 1e-4, bisection fallback.
steps.invalid_inputs: mid <= 0, NaN mid, T <= 0, S <= 0 or K <= 0 -> IV = NaN.
steps.acceptance_filter: Keep the contract only if IV is finite and 0.03 <= IV <= 3.0. Rejected contracts are dropped entirely.

steps.name: Compute Black-Scholes delta
steps.detail: sigma is the contract's own solved IV (sticky-strike, so skew is reflected). N() is the standard normal CDF.

steps.name: Drop zero-OI contracts
steps.detail: If open interest data is available, discard contracts with OI <= 0. If OI data failed to load entirely, keep all IV-valid contracts.

steps.name: Select the 25-delta strikes
steps.call: From calls with numeric delta > 0, choose argmin |delta - 0.25|.
steps.put: From puts with numeric delta < 0, choose argmin |delta - (-0.25)|.
notes: Nearest-listed-strike selection: no interpolation between strikes, so the bound snaps to a real strike.
Ties go to whichever row comes first in the chain order (Python min()).
If no candidates exist on a side, that bound is null.

steps.name: Derived skew tilt (optional)
steps.interpretation: > 0: put side wider (bearish/downside tail priced). < 0: call side wider. |skew_tilt| < 0.001 (0.10% of spot) treated as symmetric.

outputs.call_25d_iv: float | null (the selected call's IV, fractional)
outputs.put_25d_iv: float | null (the selected put's IV, fractional)

related_context_same_endpoint.atm_iv: Average IV of the call and put at the strike closest to spot (anchor expiry), ignoring missing/non-positive IVs.
related_context_same_endpoint.expected_move_1sd: spot * atm_iv * sqrt(dte_years), with dte_years = max(seconds_to_expiry, 3600) / (365*86400)
related_context_same_endpoint.atm_straddle: ATM call mid + ATM put mid
related_context_same_endpoint.regime: positive_gamma if spot >= gamma_flip else negative_gamma; unknown if gamma_flip missing
related_context_same_endpoint.walls_inside_check: In positive gamma, if put_wall > put_25d_strike and call_wall < call_25d_strike, the GEX walls (not the 25Δ strikes) are treated as the likely turning points. In negative gamma, the 25Δ put strike is treated as the realistic floor before acceleration.

pseudocode: rows = chain where quote exists and expiration >= now
anchor_date = min(r.expiration.date for r in rows); rows = [r for r in rows if r.expiration.date == anchor_date]
r.iv = solve_bs_iv(r.mid, S, r.strike, T, rate, r.type)
if not (isfinite(r.iv) and 0.03 <= r.iv <= 3.0): drop r
if oi_available and r.oi <= 0: drop r
r.delta = N(d1) if r.type == 'C' else N(d1) - 1
call_25 = argmin(|r.delta - 0.25|  for calls with delta > 0)
put_25  = argmin(|r.delta + 0.25|  for puts with delta < 0)
caveats: IV carries a variance risk premium, so realized moves often stay inside the 25Δ range on quiet days; breaches cluster in negative-gamma regimes.
Delta is model (Black-Scholes, q=0, calendar-time T) delta, not a broker-supplied delta; results can differ slightly from vendor greeks.
The 1-day T floor makes same-day (0DTE) deltas less extreme than a true intraday T would, so the 25Δ strikes sit wider than an intraday-time model would place them.

api.fields: call_25d_strike, put_25d_strike, call_25d_iv, put_25d_iv, skew_tilt (plus atm_iv, expected_move_1sd, regime, walls, read_headline, read_bullets)
